lang.title: Choose your language
ob1.title: Find a cap
ob1.body: Streets, parks, the beach — caps are everywhere once you start looking.
ob2.title: Photograph it
ob2.body: Top photo, then the side. We cut out the background — no filters, ever.
ob3.title: Fill your garage
ob3.body: Every cap becomes a 3D model on a pedestal. Compare rarity. Duel friends.
signin.title: Save your caps
signin.sub: So your garage is never lost
signin.guestnote: Guest works fully offline. You can save your garage to an account any time.
nick.title: Pick a nickname
nick.rules: 3–16 characters, no spaces. Never use your real name.
nick.realname: Looks like a real name — pick a nickname
consent.title: For parents
consent.b1: We store only a nickname, an avatar and cap photos
consent.b2: No chat, no ads, no purchases, no location
consent.b3: Friends can be added only by invite code
consent.b4: You can export or delete everything, any time
gate.title: Quick check for a grown-up
perm.title: One thing first
perm.body: We need the camera to photograph caps. Photos stay on your phone until you add them to the garage.
perm.denied.title: Camera is off
garage.title: My Garage
garage.empty.title: Your garage is empty
garage.empty.body: Find a cap outside and give it a home.
garage.placeholders: Dashed spots are waiting for your next find
collections.more: New brands appear here as you add caps
brand.silhouettes: Grey caps are in the catalog — still out there somewhere
detail.unrated: Unrated · gets a tier once 20 collectors own it
detail.viewer.hint: Drag to rotate · Double-tap to reset
dup.title: You already have this cap
cam.hints: Plain surface · Fill the circle · Avoid shadows
processing.title: Cutting out the background…
processing.note: No filters, no touch-ups. Your cap stays exactly as you found it.
saved.title: Saved!
saved.body: We’ll identify this cap when you’re back online. It’s already in your garage.
cutout.title: How does it look?
identify.title: Is this your cap?
identify.none: None of these — enter it myself
manual.title: Tell us about it
manual.unverified: Saved as Unverified — other collectors can find it after a quick review.
condition.title: Almost in the garage
condition.note: Condition — just a note, never lowers rarity
friends.title: Friends
friends.pending.title: WANTS TO BE FRIENDS
friends.note: Friends are added only by invite code. No chat, no real names.
addfriend.mycode.title: YOUR FRIEND CODE
addfriend.enter.label: Enter a friend’s code
addfriend.note: Codes only — no search, no phone numbers, no real names.
friendgarage.note: Read-only — notes and places stay private.
guestwall.title: Friends need an account
guestwall.body: You’re a guest — your garage lives only on this phone. Save it to an account to add friends and duel.
leaderboard.note: Friends only — there is no global leaderboard.
duel.rules: Best of 3. Each round, both of you secretly pick a cap — the rarer one wins the round.
duel.pick.title: Round {n} of 3 — pick a cap
duel.pick.notes: Unrated caps can’t duel yet. Fewer than 3 caps? Reusing is allowed.
duel.wait.title: Your cap is locked in
delete.title: Delete this account?
delete.body: Everything is kept for 7 days — sign back in to undo. After that, caps, badges and friends are gone for good.
link.title: Save your garage
link.body: Your guest caps merge into the account. Nothing is ever deleted.
update.title: Time to update
update.body: This version is too old to sync caps safely. Grab the new one — it takes a minute.
maintenance.title: Back in a bit
maintenance.body: We’re fixing the garage doors. Your caps are safe — try again in about 30 minutes.
